verdict.rationale: Pulley's own help docs describe downloading the cap table as an Excel file, either as of a specific date or for all time, which covers the core cap-table export on demand. Nothing in the evidence shows export of the full transaction or ledger history, or a CSV option. Missing for 10: documented export of the complete transaction history, CSV or other open-format options, details of what the 'all time' download contains, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can export my complete cap table and full transaction history to open formats (Excel/CSV) at any time — my ownership data is never held hostage

citations.quote: Cap Tables can be downloaded as of a specific date or for all time.
